correctness.rationale: A cyclic degree-three Kummer cover with seven total branch points proves geometric integrality and genus 5. Kudo 2018 Theorem 1.2 proves the untwisted \(p^2\)-Frobenius scalar \(-p\). Explicit valuations at zero, infinity and the other five branch points yield a complete basis of five regular differentials, and tame comparison yields ten order-fifteen \(H^1\) characters. Coefficient-descent cocycle yields an exact ten-factor cyclotomic Frobenius determinant; all four formulas and fifth-extension counts follow by polynomial identities and Newton sums. Finite field and integer group-ring implementations reproduced all fifteen classes over p=11 and p=29 and second-extension counts for p=11. These tests do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The fifteen natural diagonal coefficient classes of a published genus-five superspecial family are completely classified by four Jacobian Weil polynomials. Distinct isogeny classes have indistinguishable counts over the first four consecutive field extensions, and a sharp first separation at degree five. Complete natural arithmetic invariant with a motivated comparison to prior maximality/first-count results; not an arbitrary numerical slice.
